description: A side panel that renders as a Sheet on desktop and a swipeable Drawer on mobile.
overview:
`Panel` presents secondary content such as forms, filters or details without leaving the page. On desktop it renders a suiss/ui `Sheet` that slides in from the chosen side. On mobile (below `48rem`, via `useIsMobile`) it switches to a `Drawer` with a swipe handle, and every subcomponent swaps to its Drawer counterpart.

The parts mirror the Sheet and Drawer anatomy: a trigger, content with an optional close button, header, title, description, body, footer and a close control. Use it where a desktop layout calls for a side sheet and a phone calls for a bottom sheet.
usage:
- Compose `PanelTrigger` and `PanelContent` inside `Panel`. All parts must be used inside `Panel`, or they throw.
- Open state is uncontrolled by default; use `defaultOpen` for an initial state, or `open` with `onOpenChange` to control it.
- Use the `render` prop on `PanelTrigger` and `PanelClose` to render them as a suiss/ui `Button`.
- Put scrollable or form content in `PanelBody`, which applies padding that matches each presentation.

examples.OpenByDefault: Starts open with `defaultOpen` and closes from the close button.
examples.Sides: Opens the desktop sheet from the top, right, bottom and left.
examples.WithCloseLabel: Replaces the close icon with a Done text button through `closeLabel`.
examples.WithoutCloseButton: Hides the built-in close button and closes from a Cancel button instead.
examples.Floating: Insets the mobile drawer from the screen edges with `floating`.

parts.Panel: The root that chooses Sheet or Drawer and holds the open state.
parts.PanelTrigger: The button that opens the panel.
parts.PanelContent: The popup surface, with an optional close button.
parts.PanelTitle: The panel's heading, which names the dialog.
parts.PanelDescription: Supporting text that describes the dialog.
parts.PanelClose: A button that closes the panel.

Panel.onOpenChange: Called with the new open state when the panel opens or closes.
Panel.floating: Insets the mobile drawer from the screen edges. Has no effect on desktop.

PanelTrigger.render: Replaces the rendered element, for example with a `Button`.

PanelContent.side: The screen edge the desktop sheet slides in from. Ignored on mobile.
PanelContent.closeLabel: Text for the close button in place of the icon.

PanelClose.render: Replaces the rendered element, for example with a `Button`.

accessibility:
- The content is a `dialog` named by `PanelTitle` and described by `PanelDescription`.
- Escape closes the panel and returns focus to the trigger.
- The built-in close button is named Close, or by `closeLabel` when set.
notes: Styling hooks: `data-slot="panel"`, `panel-trigger`, `panel-content`, `panel-header`, `panel-title`, `panel-description`, `panel-body`, `panel-footer` and `panel-close`. The presentation follows the viewport at render time, so a panel open while the viewport crosses `48rem` re-renders in the other presentation.
